title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees
abstract: arXiv:2610.20334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex, a framework in which the agent's own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. translated_title: TreeFlex：智能体自主导航自身搜索树的框架
translated_abstract: ReAct风格的智能体在单一上下文中不断累积观察、中间结果和失败的尝试。随着上下文不断增长，过时和偏离主路径的信息会消耗其有限的容量并掩盖相关证据，使聚焦推理变得越来越困难。我们提出了TreeFlex，这是一个由智能体自身策略决定搜索方向的框架。智能体将每个中间状态连同一段简短摘要，记录为由框架（harness）维护的搜索树中的一个节点。该策略是一个承担两种角色的单一语言模型：在“反思”角色中，它通过这些摘要获得树的全局视图，并选择一个要恢复的节点及附带一条指令；在“执行”角色中，框架恢复通向该节点的路径，模型使用常规任务工具执行该指令，直到保存一个新的节点或提出解决方案，随后反思角色会批准该方案或将其送回另一个节点继续探索。
tldr: TreeFlex让单一语言模型在反思与执行两种角色间切换，在框架维护的搜索树上自主选择从哪个节点恢复搜索，从而解决ReAct式智能体因上下文膨胀导致的推理失效问题。
